rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides comprehensive integration with the EventHorizon Django event management platform through Knox token authentication. Enables complete event lifecycle management including creating, updating, and deleting events, managing user registrations with approval workflows, and accessing user profiles and hosted events. Built with TypeScript using axios for HTTP requests and zod for schema validation, offering tools for event discovery with search and location filtering, registration management for organizers, and user account operations.
